B. Award RFP No. SP2740 to Craftwater Engineering, Inc. to Prepare a Permeable Surface Alley Master Plan
Recommended Action
Staff recommends that the City Council:
1. Adopt a finding of exemptions pursuant to Section 15262 and Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines;
2. Award RFP# SP2740 to Craftwater Engineering, Inc ., a California-based company, to provide services for the development of a Permeable Surface Alley Master Plan for Public Works Department; and
3. Authorize the City Manager to negotiate and execute a professional services agreement with Craftwater Engineering, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $345,000 (including a $ 45,087 contingency) for three (3) years, with one renewal option of up to two (2) years.

Recommended Action

F. Authorization to Accept Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) 2024 Grant for Homeland Security Projects
Recommended Action
Staff recommends that the City C ouncil:
1. Adopt a finding of no possibility of significant effect pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) (Common Sense Exemption) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines;
2. Authorize the City Manager to accept a grant award in the amount of $2,498,772 from the 2024 Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) for homeland security projects in the Fire and Police Departments;
3. Authorize the City Manager to execute all necessary documents to accept the grant and any subsequent grant modifications; and
4. Authoriz e budget amendment as outlined in the Financial Impacts & Budget Actions section of this report (requires 5 votes) .

Recommended Action

1. Adopt a finding of categorical exemption s pursuant to Section 15301 and Section 15269 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
2. Ratify the Procurement Manager’s issuance of a purchase order with Jilk Heavy Construction , Inc. to repair pile 18M underneath the Santa Monica Pier for the Public Works Department.
